# fixtures/improve (v1.2.0)

Three of the owner's photos from the 2026-11-15 run under v1.1.0 (the bytes the agent received), where all three were
judged "light already good", G was skipped and the lake and the gate came out with no visible change. Next to each
photo is a director-brief parameter file written under the v1.2.0 rules (2–3 improvement `moves`), used by
`tests/test_improve.py`. The photos are © the owner and not covered by the repository licence.

`07_lake_frame_g.png` and `07_lake_frame_gpt_params.json` are the G intermediate and the agent's own brief parameters
from the owner's 2026-11-19 run under v1.2.1 (used by the v1.2.2 tests).
